min4-ops.note: 4x4 with a turn and a halt

full16-victorylap.note: 16x16 victory-lap shape: arithmetic, X, a long lap, then a wall halt

full16-forever.note: 16x16, never halts in 192 ticks, revisits the vacated @

halt-tick1.note: man is adjacent to the east wall: halts on the very first tick

halt-H-tick2.note: H reached on tick 2; man parks on the H forever

halt-H-first-cell.note: H under the start, reached after a turn

wall-corner-ne.note: last interior column then north: parks on the top wall

wall-corner-sw.note: walks the west wall low down

start-hug-north.note: start on the first interior row

start-hug-south.note: start on the last interior row

start-hug-west.note: start on the first interior column

start-hug-east.note: start on the last interior column: halts on tick 1

lap-forever.note: never halts; man walks back over the vacated @ every lap

digits-0-9.note: every digit 0-9 executed in one run

arith-grow.note: A climbs 9,18,...,81 (colour is unaffected, but the man must not stall)

arith-negative.note: A dives 0,-9,-18,... : negative A held across ticks

all-op-classes.note: ^ > v < digits M + - X H all present

M-not-swap.note: '9MX': B=A keeps A=9 so X turns CW; a swap would leave A=0

M-then-arith.note: '9M0-' needs B to still hold 9 (A=-9, X turns CCW)

plus-not-minus.note: '+' must ADD: A=4>0 turns CW; if it subtracted A=-2 turns CCW

X-reads-A-not-B.note: A=0, B=2: X must NOT turn (sign of A, not of B)

swan-dive-clone.note: public 'swan dive' shape: '+' and '-' as INSTRUCTIONS

pm-first-row.note: a full run of '-'/'+' on the first interior row, hugging the walls

pm-false-wall-row.note: an interior row that looks exactly like a wall

pm-false-corner-col.note: interior columns of '+' and '-' that mimic wall columns

pm-under-corner.note: an entire fake ROOM drawn inside the real room out of +/-

pm-arith-adjacent.note: '+' instructions running right up to the east wall

pm-corner-neighbours.note: +/- ops in every cell that touches a real wall

man-on-last-pixel.note: man halts on the display corner pixel (15,14)

dense16-ops.note: every interior cell carries an op: max colour variety

wrap64-positive.note: A doubles from 9 until it wraps NEGATIVE past 2**63; the X on the ring then turns the wrong way and the man dies on a wall

wrap64-negative.note: A doubles from -9 until it wraps POSITIVE past -2**63; the X then turns the wrong way

max-rounds-30.note: 29 step rounds (30 total), 174 ticks: maximum frame traffic

k-values-8-16-59.note: k values the rest of the suite never uses

max-rounds-k1.note: 29 rounds of k=1 on a forever-lap: one delta per round

corner-halt-nw.note: never actually reaches the corner: walks west into the west wall

corner-halt-se-16.note: halt at the far display edge of a full-size program

worst-tick-dense16.note: densest 16x16 + 30 rounds: the most expensive shape the spec permits

zero-delta-12.note: 12-cell lap stepped 12 at a time: every frame identical to the last

zero-delta-16.note: 16x16 lap: 52 ticks is exactly one lap, so no pixel changes

oos-post-halt.note: step commands after the halt (spec says they never arrive)

oos-k64-x8.note: 512 ticks (spec says at most 200 per case)

oos-inset-room-tl.note: 6x5 room inset by 1 inside an 8x8 program grid

oos-inset-room-br.note: room pushed to the bottom-right of the program grid
